offering_description.value: Provides truckload freight hauling across the United States, Mexico and Canada, using company-owned tractors and trailers and drivers. It sells transport capacity to shippers under contracts and on spot freight, and earns per-mile or per-load fees.

primary_services.value: truckload freight hauling; dedicated contract carriage; cross-border trucking; intermodal and logistics services

customer_segment.value: B2B: manufacturers, retailers, distributors and other shippers needing freight moved

end_markets.value: manufacturing; retail; consumer goods; automotive; food and beverage

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-mile or per-load fees for hauling freight for shippers; project or contract: dedicated fleet contracts with shippers for committed capacity

value_chain_position.value: service provider: moves shippers' freight by truck and sells transport capacity to them; asset operator: owns and runs a fleet of tractors and trailers and employs drivers

geography_served.value: North America: Continental US states, plus cross-border service into Mexico and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: truckload dry van service, dedicated contract carriage and logistics services sharing shippers and fleet

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with shippers and national accounts; agents / brokers: freight brokers and third-party logistics firms that place loads with the company

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: US DOT and FMCSA safety, hours-of-service and vehicle rules, plus cross-border trucking rules for Mexico and Canada
